subject.title: BL-buying-account-14: address/collect-method update by index skips range validation

question: Should the range-guard fix wait for the BL-buying-account extraction PR to land, or should a fix PR add the missing BL-14 artifact now?
rationale: The runtime bug is clear, but the issue explicitly requires updating BL-14 spec/test files that are still owned by an open, conflicting BL extraction PR rather than current dev.

options.title: Wait for BL PR, then fix
options.body: Repair and land the BL extraction PR first, then apply this small behavior fix against the completed BL artifact set.

options.title: Fix now with BL-14 artifacts
options.body: Open a targeted fix PR that adds the missing BL-14 spec/test plus the repository guards, accepting possible conflicts with the open BL extraction PR.

options.title: Fold into BL PR
options.body: Change the open BL extraction PR to include the behavior fix, trading speed for a departure from the BL pipeline's no-behavior-change rule.

recommendation.title: Wait for BL PR, then fix
recommendation.body: Repair and land the BL extraction PR first, then apply this small behavior fix against the completed BL artifact set.

likelyOwner.reason: MiguelHamelyn is the named Seller Account BL owner and already reviewed the related extraction PR, so this sequencing choice is closest to that ownership boundary.
